theme: An open day, with a few bookings quietly running out of runway.
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — nothing is on the calendar. The only things with a clock on them are a couple of travel bookings that have drifted past their dates.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 Todoist booking is still open and overdue since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest inventory in that market, so a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist-and-book task hits its Oct 15 booking deadline in three days. Holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the decision is what unlocks everything downstream.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 Portland-to-St Pete drive window is the off-week gap between girl-weeks. Setting the dates and booking the one hotel night locks it in before the window closes.

flagged.title: Two exec-role alerts overnight
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a Citi Head of Business Development (MD) role and an LHH Director/VP of Capital Markets opening — worth a skim, though both are generic alerts rather than outreach.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, receipts and promos — a Chase statement ($184.93, due Nov 8, autopay on), a Disney+ receipt, and the usual language-app and local digests.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's apples are at their peak now, and a butterscotch tart puts them to work in the oven.

acts.line: No meetings anywhere on the calendar — the morning is wide open before anything can claim it.
The afternoon stays just as clear; the day asks nothing of you but what you choose to give it.
Tomorrow opens early with a nine o'clock appointment, so an earlier evening sets it up well.
